metadata.description: 47 skills and 19 agents for software engineering: knowledge, tools, frameworks, playbooks, roles, and agents, plus the loop-virtuoso Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: knowledge-virtuoso
plugins.description: 15 knowledge skills: design patterns, refactoring, SOLID, debugging, clean architecture, testing, API design, security, scrum, performance, microservices, git workflow, CI/CD, accessibility, and database design

plugins.name: tools-virtuoso
plugins.description: 11 tool skills: rules writer, ticket writer, agent creator, plugin creator, brainstorming, ecosystem advisor, PR message writer, report writer, stakeholder update writer, web screenshot, and image annotate

plugins.name: frameworks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 4 framework skills: Symfony components, Symfony upgrade, Django components, and LangChain components

plugins.name: playbooks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 5 playbook skills: PHP upgrade, Composer dependencies, branch finishing, ticket delivery, and worktree ops

plugins.name: agents-virtuoso
plugins.description: 19 agents, 3 pre-composed teams, 7 role skills, and agent workflow skills: delegation patterns, team library, team dispatcher, subagent-driven development, verification discipline, plus all specialist and role agents

plugins.name: loop-virtuoso
plugins.description: Claude Code only. A backlog-driven delivery loop that feeds the agent one small item at a time and accepts it only when verify commands pass and a write-boundary guard approves. Ships hooks, scripts, commands, and 2 skills
